## About
Certified Alignments is a small automotive shop in Temple Hills, set up to quickly and specifically take care of your vehicle's alignment, front-end suspension and other ride-related needs.
Alignments are what we're known for. We use the latest Hunter equipment and work on most cars, SUV's and light trucks, plus custom wheels and lifted or lowered vehicles. We also handle brakes, ball joints and tie-rods, shocks and struts, C.V. drive axles, and tire mounting and balancing.
Word of mouth brings a lot of folks through our door. One reviewer came in on a referral from a satisfied customer, another was sent over by their own mechanic, and a third says they've sent other people our way.
We're rated 4.7 on Google from 270 reviews. One reviewer wrote that Brown and Chet, our owner and manager, answered all their questions from the phone call to the service center. Call us with your questions first.

## Services
- Latest Technology 4-Wheel Alignments: Alignments done on our Hunter equipment, including custom wheels.
- Install Front Pads: Labor to install a set of front brake pads. (From $95)
- Install Rotors & Pads: Labor to install a set of brake rotors and pads. (From $120)
- Shocks & Struts: Replacement of worn shocks and struts, priced per piece.
- C.V. Drive Axles: Replacement of C.V. drive axles as part of your front-end and ride work.
- Control Arm: Labor to replace a control arm. (From $150)
- Tire Mounting: Tire mounting labor. (From $25)
- Parts inspection only: A look at your front-end parts so you know what's going on before any work is done. (From $30)

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: For the fastest service, please call ahead for an appointment. We can get booked up, and one reviewer mentioned leaving their car with us for that reason.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 10 to 5. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How much does an alignment cost?
A: Most cars, SUV's and light trucks are between $95 to $120. Some camber and caster adjustments, heat, bushings or shims cost extra.

Q: Can you align custom wheels or lifted and lowered vehicles?
A: Yes. We align up to 30" custom wheels. Custom wheels, lifted, lowered and modified vehicles are at additional cost.
